invariants.rationale: deletePrepped always returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata.
List of records to delete is expected to be provided and non-null.
The instant time is a required operation identifier, so should be non-null and non-empty.
An engine context object is necessary for execution and thus should be non-null.
The metadata must include write statuses, hence getWriteStatuses() should not be null.
